utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the exact drop-off spot—can you confirm it’s the community center on Sunday? I just want to make sure I bring everything to the right place.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, the community center on Sunday sounds right. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: 3 o’clock works for me, as long as it’s the community center on Sunday. I just want to be sure I’m bringing things to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still planning to swing by the repair drive and help out for a bit. I’ll tell the others too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you check what still needs fixing yet?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not yet, but I’m going to check and see what they still need. I’ll let the others know too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I’m asking around now and I’ll let you know what they still need for the repair drive. I’m a bit forgetful, but I haven’t forgotten!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Oren — if you hear what they still need, just pass it along. I’m curious when they’re planning to do it too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’ll ask around and let you know the needs and timing as soon as I hear. I’m a little forgetful, but I’ve got it on my list!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. Late is best for me—just knock softly and we’ll keep it easy.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps. I’ll stop by late and keep it quiet—just let me know if you hear any last-minute updates.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — if you can keep connecting folks, that’d be a big help. I’m still bringing the patch mix and filler, and I can help coordinate drop-offs too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll ask neighbors to bring small repairs or tools. Thanks for coordinating drop-offs too!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Jules — I’ll keep track of the drop-offs and make sure the patch mix and filler are ready for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Sunday at the community center now — thanks for spreading the word. I might still need a reminder, but I’ll try to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can remind you again if you want. The repair drive is Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Rey — I’d appreciate a reminder. I’ll do my best to make it over Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what kind of repair help do you need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d want to confirm the current list of fixes and remind everyone the drive is now on Sunday at the community center. Then I can help with the right thing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help confirm the current fixes and spread the word that it’s on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday at the community center works better. No specific time yet — I’ll confirm soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just let me know the time, and I’ll bring the tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll send the time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m already telling folks about the repair drive, and I’ll keep spreading the word around the neighborhood right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn—I'll check the bulletin board and see when it starts. If you hear the time before I do, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still not sure on the time—could you check with Opal or whoever posted it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got it noted: the repair drive is Sunday at the community center. I’ll put the details on the community hall bulletin board.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — that works for me. I’ll check the board for the time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on a few basics, so I’m keeping track of what comes in. If you hear of any extra supplies, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, what time is the repair drive happening and where should people drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It starts at 4 in the community hall, and folks can drop supplies off at the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane—everything’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. If you can help set up and bring those tools, that would be a big help, and please let folks know the new location.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I can help set up and bring some basic tools, and I’ll spread the word about Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is starting soon. If you want, I can help spread the word a little.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — what time is the repair drive happening? I can work around the school schedule once I know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure of the exact time yet, but I can ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What time is it set for, and can you confirm it’s definitely at the community hall?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check on the exact time and drop-off details while I’m out. I’ll get back to you as soon as I can confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — please do, and let me know the exact time and hall details when you’ve confirmed them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It’s now on Sunday at the community center, and I still want to confirm what needs fixing before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it — Sunday at the community center works for me, I just need the list of what still needs fixing before I can plan the drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — I’m checking the list now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s still set for Sunday at the community center. I can keep track of what still needs fixing if you want.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be great, Opal — thanks for helping keep track. I’ll let folks know it’s Sunday at the community center and send them your way with any questions.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll keep a running list of anything that still needs fixing, and send people your way if they have questions.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — Sunday at the community center now, got it. I’ll try to make it by and help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m a bit out of the loop, but I can help with whatever’s still left—just point me to the list. If you’ve got any easy tasks, I’ll take one.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll bring my tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Leo—Sunday at the community center it is, and your tools will help a lot. We’ll start with the edge cracks first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll start with the edge cracks when I get there Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on a few basics, but the screwdrivers, hammer, duct tape, and boxes should help a lot. If you can spread the word, that’d be great too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps — I’ll spread the word and tell folks those basics are still needed too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — I really appreciate it. If anyone can also bring tape, gloves, or a few more boxes, that would help us finish up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, I’m still spreading the word about the repair drive and asking neighbors to pitch in with tools or a few hands. If you can come by, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What time are you thinking for the repair drive? I like to plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I don’t have the exact time yet, but I’m expecting it to start sometime soon today. I’ll pass along the timing as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can bring the patch mix and filler for the repair drive, and I can help coordinate who’s dropping things off if that would help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara — that would help a lot. I’ll try to make it to the repair drive on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Uli — I’ll bring the patch mix and filler, and I can help sort out drop-offs too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — the community hall bulletin board should work for the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, let’s use the community hall bulletin board then—just tell me what details to put up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what kind of repair help do you need for the drive?
